old_issue: The existing note describes the downstream reduction as unregulated.

old_issue: The rationale groups vitamin D with products made directly from cholesterol, although the skin substrate is the biosynthetic precursor 7-dehydrocholesterol.
correction: Distinguish the common sterol pathway from direct conversion of cholesterol into bile acids and steroid hormones.
